scripts.build:experimental-binary: cargo build --release --manifest-path native/supervisor/Cargo.toml --locked && bun run build:tui && bun tools/build-experimental-binary.mjs
scripts.build: bun run build:supervisor && bun run build:tui && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: test -z "$(gofmt -l native/tui)" && go -C native/tui mod verify && go -C native/tui vet ./... && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/supervisor/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/supervisor/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && node tools/verify-architecture.mjs
scripts.test: bun run build:supervisor && cargo test --manifest-path native/supervisor/Cargo.toml --locked && go -C native/tui test ./... && bun test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:experimental-binary: bun run build:experimental-binary && bun test tests/darwin/binary-distribution.test.ts
scripts.tui: bun run build:supervisor && bun run build:tui && bun src/tui.ts
scripts.verify: bun run parity:check && bun run check-types && bun run lint && bun run build && bun run test && bun run eval:efficiency
